result.root_cause: Tar archive entry names from an untrusted pod are joined to the destination directory without normalization/containment validation, so an entry like "../pwned.txt" escapes the destination on extraction.
result.summary: Our patch is a correct and complete fix: it applies the canonical-path containment check (canonicalize destination and entry, require the entry to equal or start with destination + separator) at the exact extraction sink in Copy.copyDirectoryFromPod. This closes the whole traversal class — including symlink and encoding variants — rather than just the observed '../pwned.txt' payload, and is a strict superset of the official FilenameUtils.normalize null-check. POV no longer reproduces, regressions pass, and legitimate in-destination entries are preserved.
